scope: Discretionary suggested purchase prices for four existing items without a verified printed price. These are not transcriptions or price quotations; the DM may change them.
currencyConvention: The PHB p.35 monetary system gives 20 sp = 1 gp.

records.basis: A plain wooden staff is assumed to require less manufacture than the PHB p.35 spear at 1 gp (20 sp) or UA p.26 sap at 1 gp. The 5 sp figure is a discretionary quarter of either comparator, not a printed bo-stick price.

Assumes a simply shaped purchased wooden club; the UA p.26 sap is 1 gp (20 sp). A lower 2 sp suggestion is a judgment about simple materials and workmanship, not a printed club price or a rule preventing scavenging a club.

Assumes a plain prepared wooden staff, without a metal point; the PHB p.35 spear is 1 gp (20 sp) and UA p.26 staff sling is 2 gp (40 sp). The 5 sp suggestion is an arbitrary lower price, not a printed quarterstaff price.

The PHB p.35 lists 20 sling bullets for 10 sp. This suggestion assumes a purchased, selected set of 20 stones costs less than manufactured bullets; 1 sp is a discretionary package price, not a printed stone price. Suitable stones might instead be gathered at the DM's discretion.
